## Ctx.resolveMediaInput() method

Resolve a template media `src` into an uploadable value.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static resolveMediaInput(src: string | InputFile | Buffer | Uint8Array | undefined, filename?: string, roots?: readonly string[] | null): string | InputFile;
```

`InputFile` for local files and binary payloads, otherwise `src` unchanged.

## Remarks

When `src` points at a real local file (`existsSync` + `statSync().isFile()`<!-- -->), it is wrapped in `new InputFile(src, filename)` so grammy uploads it. `file_id` values, URLs, and missing paths pass through unchanged — never throws. Pre-built `InputFile` instances pass through as-is when no `filename` is given; a defined `filename` returns a prototype-preserving clone (`Object.create` + `Object.assign`<!-- -->) so shared caller instances are never mutated. `Buffer`<!-- -->/`Uint8Array` payloads are wrapped in `new InputFile(src, filename)`<!-- -->.

Opt-in local-path jail (Q8 option b): when `roots` is a non-empty list, a local file uploads ONLY when its resolved absolute form sits under one of the resolved roots — otherwise it passes through unchanged (sent as a `file_id`<!-- -->, never throws, never uploads). `null`<!-- -->/empty `roots` keeps current behavior unchanged. `file_id`<!-- -->/URL/`Buffer`<!-- -->/`InputFile` sources are unaffected by the jail. Symlink limitation: the check is lexical (`resolve` without `realpath` — see `Ctx.isPathUnderRoots`<!-- -->).
